This is a small compilation of resources which will be expanded upon in the future. This is intended to kickstart the process of looking into gaming history for any aspiring researchers, as well as serve as a database for anybody who would like to have references to come back to.

I have my own database done in Google spreadsheet which I will explain in a later post, but I'll leave it here for now for those interested.

Books:

Zap!: The Rise and Fall of Atari | Scott Cohen

Atari Inc. Business is Fun | Martin Goldberg and Kurt Vendel

All Your Base Are Belong to Us | Harold Goldberg

The Ultimate History of Video Games | Steven Kent

Game Over: How Nintendo Zapped an American Industry, Captured Your Dollars, and Enslaved Your Children | David Sheff

Replay: The History of Video Games | Tristan Donovan

Video Invaders: Everything You Want to Know About Video Games Plus How to Beat Them! | Steve Bloom

Dungeons and Dreamers: The Rise of Computer Game Culture from Geek to Chic | Brad King and John Borland

Videogames: In the Beginning | Ralph Baer

Down From the Top of Its Game: The Story of Infocom | Hector Briceño, Wesley Chao, Andrew Glenn, Stanley Hu, Ashwin Krishnamurthy, and Bruce Tsuchida

Pheonix: The Rise & Fall of Videogames | Leonard Herman

Masters of Doom: How Two Guys Created an Empire and Transformed Pop Culture | David Kushner

Generation Xbox: How Videogames Invaded Hollywood | Jamie Russell

Console Wars: Sega, Nintendo, and the Battle that Defined a Generation | Blake Harris

Power-Up: How Japanese Video Games Gave the World an Extra Life | Chris Kohler

Service Games: The Rise and Fall of SEGA | Sam Pettus, David Muñoz, Kevin Williams, Ivan Barroso, and David Chen

The Untold History of Japanese Game Developers: Volume 1 | S.M.G Szczepaniak

Before the Crash : The Early History of Video Games | Mark J. P. Wolf, Jessica Aldred, Ralph Baer , Brett Camper, Karen Collins, Ross A. Dannenberg, Leonard Herman, Erkki Huhtamo, Carly A. Kocurek, Sheila C. Murphy, Ed Rotberg, Tim Skelly, Carl Therrien, Staci Tucker, and Zach Whalen

Discussion of these resources should be done in this thread. If you would like to share a resource for the list, please post it below.

This is where we can discuss the entries which are in the Games History Resources: Survivalist Guide post. If you have a suggestion for the list, post it in that forum.

We can post our experiences with these sources, corrections, the way these should be arranged, upcoming resources, and whether or not a specific source should be included. I want this to be a community discussion so we can discuss the validity of canonical texts versus what may be inappropriate for research purposes. We are not Wikipedia, after all.

The Survivalist Guide exists for newcomers and oldcomers alike to find verifiable information regarding events, topics, developments, newspapers, etc. If there are inaccuracies or contradicting information, be sure to talk about it here.

Also feel free to critique my own database as I intend to put it up to the standards of the community.
